newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES MIXED ON KEY UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES MIXED ON KEY UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed Thursday's session weaker on the U.S. currency on import payments but marginally firmer on sterling and the mark, foreign exchange dealers said.
"The dollar weakened on the U.S. dollar due to a number of big payments being made out," one dealer said.
At Thursday's close, the local unit was quoted at 10.2850/3050 on the U.S. dollar from its 10.2700/2900 position late Wednesday and at 2.2910/3000 on the rand from 2.2800/2900.
It was a tad firmer on the crosses, however, reflecting a softening of the U.S. currency against the mark and sterling on overseas markets.
It was last indicated at 16.0030/0500 on sterling versus 16.0100/0500 and on the mark at 6.8020/8210 from 6.8100/8300 previously.
